title: GaAs: second-harmonic generation and shift current
summary: Bulk GaAs with PAW pseudopotentials on a 62-orbital PAO basis (internal projections, all-electron augmenting shells): chi_xyz(omega) and the shift and injection currents with a 0.86 eV scissor from PAOFLOW.nonlinear_optics. Holds the validation report of the non-linear optics (graphene model, GaAs, GeS) and the script of its figures.

steps.label: Shift current, injection currents and SHG of GaAs
steps.note: 40^3 k-points: about 2.5 min on 8 ranks; writes output/

steps.label: Figures of the validation report
steps.note: figures/fig2_gaas from output/; Fig. 1 and 3 from ../graphene_nlo_model/output and ../ges_nlo/output when those cases sit next to this one
